items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story involving 'Alec' (Alex Scott) fixing a bass, but the interaction described is primarily between Alec, Frank, and the drunk patron. The interviewee ('I') states 'I ain't going to give you nothing' in the context of Alec wanting money, but this appears to be the interv

ctx.x: That's why he's got a Gable.

That's like we played the Boston club, one was New Year's Eve night, and one of them big guys come, the only ship, the ship line out there, he came in the club and he had something wrapped up which was liquor in a bottle, see. And he come in, he was all stewed up. And he came over to the band and said, I say, stop that music. Well we looked at him, so Frank, he's, I don't pay him no mind. So he kept on, I say, stop that music. That music sounds like hell to me when I'm drunk. Stop that music. And he got right…
